chrome.last-fetch-hint: Time of the last successful read
banner.file.title: This page was opened over file://.
banner.file.body: The browser turns /api/v1/* into local file paths, so the daemon is unreachable. The page still renders, without data.
banner.file.hint: Serve it locally: python -m http.server 8788 --directory apps/console, or use a same-origin proxy.
overview.empty.reasons: health.reasons is empty: no degraded reason was reported.
overview.stale: These values come from the last successful read and may be out of date.
common.missing-title: This field is not in the v0 response whitelist
alerts.scope: Filters and search apply only to the loaded page. The server takes limit and cursor only; other parameters return 400.
alerts.state.not-read-detail: Press Read to pull one page from /api/v1/alerts.
alerts.state.empty-detail: The server returned an empty array: there really are none. A failed read returns 503, not an empty list.
alerts.state.filtered-detail: Every alert on this page was filtered out. Filtering applies to the loaded page only; the server has no query filter.
detail.title: Details
detail.note.whitelist: Only list-endpoint whitelist fields appear here. v0 has no evidence refs, no raw payload and no single-item route.
detail.note.evidence: evidence_count counts retained event ids on the alert row, not evidence-table rows; count may be larger.
detail.note.report: report_available=false means no report row, not a failed analysis. The chain stops at analysis_outbox.
analysis.hint: The chain stops at analysis_outbox. report_available=false means no report row, not a failure. v0 has no detail route.
analysis.state.empty-detail: The server returned an empty array: there really are none. A failed read returns 503, not an empty list.
settings.ui-mode.warning: Not wired: 0.0.1 has no desktop shell, so this only saves a local preference.
settings.language-hint: Interface language; the switch applies immediately without a reload
settings.language-note: Stored in localStorage['ui.locale']; the desktop shell and the installer read the same key.
settings.model-hint: Model entry used by the analysis chain
settings.model-note: 0.0.1 makes no model calls; the broker is not wired, so this only shows the configured entry.
settings.budget-hint: Token budget class of a single analysis
settings.budget-note: The budget class comes from the server field budget_class; the console only displays it.
error.file.title: Local server required
error.file.detail: This page was opened over file://, so the browser never sends /api/v1/* to the daemon.
error.file.hint: Start python -m http.server 8788 --directory apps/console, or let a proxy serve both the page and /api/v1/*.
error.offline.title: Service not running
error.offline.detail: Connection refused or blocked as cross-origin. The page does not spin and retry; check that the daemon listens.
error.auth.title: Authentication required
error.auth.detail: The request was rejected: the Bearer token is missing or wrong.
error.rate.title: Authentication throttled
error.rate.detail: Too many failures from the same loopback address within the window.
error.forbidden.title: Request rejected
error.bad-request.title: Request not accepted
error.not-found.title: Endpoint not found
error.store.title: Service not ready
error.server.title: Internal service error
error.http.title: Request failed (HTTP {status})
error.read.title: Read failed
error.hint.400: Invalid query parameters. The console only sends limit and cursor, so this code means the address was rewritten.
error.hint.401: A Bearer token is required. Enter it under Settings → Connection in direct mode; a proxy must inject it.
error.hint.429: Too many failed authentication attempts. Wait for Retry-After instead of guessing again.
error.hint.503: Storage unavailable or service not ready. This is not the same as having no data.
